title: 2 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on 2 Corinthians 5: the building from God in the heavens, walking by faith, the judgment seat of Christ, and the ministry of reconciliation.

questions.text: What do they have if the earthly house of their tent is dissolved?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

answers.text: A tent made with hands, like the first one
A letter written in their hearts by the Spirit
A temple built of stones in the heavens
A building from God, not made with hands, eternal in the heavens

questions.text: What did God give them, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says that he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

answers.text: The tablets of stone
The down payment of the Spirit
A letter of commendation
The armor of righteousness

questions.text: How do they walk, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

answers.text: By faith, not by sight
By sight, not by faith
By the letter, not by the Spirit
By the flesh, not by the Spirit

questions.text: What does the writer say they are willing rather to do, in verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says they are courageous and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

answers.text: To stay at home in the body as long as possible
To be sent on a journey to Judea by them
To be absent from the body and at home with the Lord
To be unclothed and so be found naked

questions.text: What do they make it their aim to be, whether at home or absent?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says they make it their aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

answers.text: To be well pleasing to him
To be commended by men
To be free of all affliction
To be first among the apostles

questions.text: Before what must they all be revealed, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says they must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

answers.text: Before the assembly of Corinth
Before the children of Israel
Before the apostles of the assemblies
Before the judgment seat of Christ

questions.text: What judgment lies behind the saying that the love of Christ constrains them?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says the love of Christ constrains them, because they judge that one died for all, therefore all died.

answers.text: That all have become rich through his poverty
That one died for all, therefore all died
That the dead are not raised at all
That the law has been abolished

questions.text: For whom should those who live no longer live, according to verse 15?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says he died for all, so that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

answers.text: For the saints who are in Jerusalem and Judea
For the assemblies of Macedonia and Achaia
No longer for themselves, but for him who died and rose again for them
For those who boast in appearance and commend themselves

questions.text: What does verse 17 say about anyone who is in Christ?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says that if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation; the old things have passed away and all things have become new.

answers.text: He is a new creation; the old things have passed away
He is still in his sins and under the law
He is a servant of the letter that kills
He is still under the veil of the old covenant

questions.text: What does verse 20 call them, on behalf of Christ?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says they are ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by them, begging the Corinthians to be reconciled to God.

answers.text: Judges over the world
Ambassadors on behalf of Christ
Letters of commendation
Heirs of the Kingdom
